010554374.eligibility: 501(c)(3) organizations with a proven operating model.

010554374.how_to_apply: Complete the online PCF Grant Application and email the supporting documents (IRS letter, two years of income statements and balance sheets, current budget, board list) to the grants address.

010554374.notes: All-volunteer foundation founded in 2001 by residents of The Peninsula community on Lake Norman, north of Charlotte. Local to north Mecklenburg County; an Asheville-area food program is outside its stated area. The website field here is the foundation's own application form, not a home page.
